title: 2021 playoff #275 Chazz Surratt Minnesota Vikings Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2021 Panini Playoff Kickoff trading card features Chazz Surratt of the Minnesota Vikings. The card is part of the modern era (1970-now) and is an original, not a reprint. It is a single card from the 2021 playoff set and has the card number 275. 

The card is in excellent shape and is near mint/mint condition. It is a sports trading card and is perfect for any football fan or collector. The brand of the card is Playoff and it is manufactured by the Panini Group. Add this card to your collection today!
